# Judith Chapter 3 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Judith 3 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/JDT_003_page_001.jpg

---

**1** One after another, the nations sent peace delegations to Holofernes.

**2** "We are the servants of Nebuchadnezzar the great king. We throw ourselves before you. Do whatever you like with us.

**3** Our estates, our land, our fields, our flocks, our herds, our encampments — everything is yours. Take it all.

**4** Our cities and everyone in them — your slaves. Come and do with us as you see fit."

**5** The messengers came to Holofernes and delivered their surrender terms.

**6** He marched down to the coast with his army, took control of every fortified city, and drafted their best fighting men into his auxiliary forces.

**7** The local populations came out to meet him with flowers and music and dancing — garlands, tambourines, celebrations.

**8** Then he got to work. He demolished their border sanctuaries, cut down their sacred groves. His mandate was clear: destroy every god in every land, so that all nations would worship Nebuchadnezzar alone — every tongue, every tribe, calling his name as divine.

**9** He pressed on toward Esdraelon, making camp near Dothan, within sight of the great ridge that marks the approach to Judea.

**10** He settled in between Geba and Scythopolis for a full month, restocking his supply lines before the next push.
